title: layout-unify — one coherent AI 2 card page layout

set.request: One coherent AI2 card page layout: chat as the right-hand column (a third at 1920/3440, footer at 390), exactly one chat scroll area with ext/Chat smart scroll, no white void, keep earlier fixes, remove dead CSS; prove with headless shots on the Dictate and ai-dashboard cards. Full ask: requirements.md.
steps: Read git status + diff of ai2/ and ext/Chat/
Measure the current card page headless (scroll areas, void)
Rewrite the card-page layout CSS as one rule set
Remove dead CSS from the competing edits
Prove: shots at 3440/1920 on Dictate + ai-dashboard, 390 on one; scroll-area count; console errors

links.label: a sub-card open: card | sub-card | chat

set.outcome:
**Every AI 2 card now has one layout: the chat is the right-hand column, with one scroll area.**

On a wide screen a card shows card | chat, with the chat taking a third of the room. With a sub-card open it shows card | sub-card | chat, and the chat on screen is the deepest open card's. On a phone the chat is the footer. The chat no longer jumps to the bottom when a sub-card opens, it opens on the newest line, and each resize handle moves only the two columns beside it.

![](sub-card-open-1920.png)

- Try it: [Dictate card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/prompt-mechanics-2/) · [a sub-card open](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/prompt-mechanics-2/chat-as-right-hand-column/) · [AI dashboard card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/ai-dashboard/)
- How it works: [columns and seams](/framework/ai2/doc/columns-seams/) · [smart scroll](/framework/ext/Chat/doc/scroll/)
- Left open: ext/Chat/Mic.js still caps the text box at about 12 lines on purpose. That file belongs to the dictation manager, and manager-new-card has been told.
